settings.title: Track Your Order
settings.text:
As soon as your order ships, we email you a confirmation with your tracking number and a link to follow your parcel.

How to check your order

  1. Open the shipping confirmation email from Lithella and click Track your order.
  2. Or sign in to your account and open Orders to see the status of every order.
  3. Can't find the email? Check your spam folder, or contact us with your order number and we'll send it again.

Shipping times

Orders are prepared within 1–3 business days. You'll see the estimated delivery time at checkout.
